title: HustleBox v1.3.2 — Softlock Hotfix + Back Room Cutscene
message:
Hotfix for the v1.3.1 APK softlock plus the back room entry cutscene you asked for.

FIXED: APK SOFTLOCK ON 'OPEN THE WINDOW'
In v1.3.1 I introduced a per-second shift counter to keep the End Shift button label live-updating. I put the useState/useEffect hooks AFTER the early-return for the parked-truck view by accident. That's a React rules-of-hooks violation: when you tapped 'Open the Window', shiftActive flipped to true and React tried to call hooks that didn't exist on the previous render. Component crashed silently, leaving the screen empty. The web build hid the error in console; the APK didn't. Moved the hooks to the top of the component with all the other state. Should work everywhere now.

BACK ROOM ENTRY CUTSCENE
First-person POV. You see the alley floor in perspective. Your feet shuffle forward and backward. A wooden door grows in size as you walk toward it — feeling like you're getting closer. The brass doorknob pulses with a warm glow. Your arm reaches in from below the frame, hand approaching the knob. The whole scene fades to black, and the back room appears.

A whisper plays subtitle-style at the bottom: "knock three. pause. knock two."

Whole cutscene takes about 4 seconds. Skip button in the top-right corner if you've seen it enough. Plays once per session of opening the back room (navigating to another tab and back replays it; backing out of a game inside the room does NOT replay it).

The cutscene doesn't play during a lockout — Ray's keeping the door locked, you don't get inside.

CAMERA NOTCH / STATUS BAR CLEARANCE
Minimum top padding on the topbar bumped to 36px (was variable based on safe-area-inset). On phones where env(safe-area-inset-top) reports 0 even though the WebView overlaps with a camera punch or status bar, content was getting clipped behind the system UI. The new minimum should clear standard Pixel-class punch holes.

HOME TRUCK CARD: BIGGER ON MOBILE
Workplace card scene height bumped from 110px to 132px on mobile so the truck's cab window doesn't look cropped. Desktop stays at 110px (kept compact per your earlier request).

No save data wiped.
